description.narrative: ERM will be providing services to WayCool in India to develop an Environmental and Social Management System (ESMS). Established in 2015, WayCool Foods & Products PVT LTD is an Agri Tech company active in the Supply Chain Technologies space in India. The funding objective of this project is to integrate ESG considerations across WayCool’s value chain and proposed expansion plans through the development of an ESMS.
